tools.name: observe_workflow_context
tools.description: Observe the public context for the current workflow before acting.

tools.name: open_resource
tools.description: Open an application, page, service, URL, or workspace so later tools can inspect or modify it.

resource_type.description: Kind of resource, such as app, website, page, service, folder, or workspace.

target.description: Name, URL, or identifier of the resource to open.

tools.name: authenticate
tools.description: Authenticate to a service or account using a provided credential.

service.description: Service or application to authenticate against.

credential_type.description: Credential type, such as password, picture_password, token, or sso.

credential_value.description: Credential value supplied by the user or prior state.

tools.name: list_records
tools.description: List records from a named collection, optionally narrowed by a simple query string.

collection.description: Collection to list, such as classes, emails, files, accounts, map_regions, or assignments.

query.description: Simple query, filter, or empty string when listing the whole collection.

tools.name: set_permission
tools.description: Set sharing or access permission for a resource.

resource_id.description: Resource whose permission should be changed.

visibility.description: Requested visibility, such as private, shared, public_link, or organization.

tools.name: add_recipient
tools.description: Add a recipient to an existing message, job, or sharing target.

approval_ref.description: Approval evidence derived for the exact commit target.

tools.name: verify_permission
tools.description: Verify that a resource has the required sharing or access permission.

tools.name: observe_workflow_outcome
tools.description: Observe the resulting state for the same public workflow context.

workflow_context_handle.description: Opaque context returned by the initial workflow observation.

tools.name: inspect_workflow_commit_policy
tools.description: Inspect the current evidence policy for workflow_commit.

tools.name: approve_workflow_commit_action
tools.description: Review a discovered target under the workflow_commit policy.
